signature: “AUGUST FRIEDRICH KRAUSE IN BERLIN ANNO. 1795”. [my own records say ”AUGUST * FRIEDRICH * KRAUSE * BERLIN” ]
dimensions: L 1945, be 123.5, mp entry 12.5, slide sec. exit 10.3, bo1 11.1, bo2 11.3 (slightly bent; both probably the same), bell sec. entry 12.3,  garland 53 along surface of bell, 41 axial, ext. diam. tube just before bell bow 14; just after bell bow 14,
literature: Waterhouse 1993: 215; Lane 1982: 79; Klaus 1998: 56. Examined by the author, June 1999.
remarks: Lower slide tube has marks to show alignment, like Schmied instruments (mark like letter v on immoveable portion matches mirror-image mark on moveable section), ferrules have ring pattern, showing crimps, no saddle or ring on slide bow, tubular slide stays, moveable slide stay telecopic, 6 ferrules on slide sec.; flat bell stay with hole, no decoration; pin (72mm) in hinge on bell-pipe side; ferrules in bell sec. mathc slide sec.; no saddle, no ring in bell bow; Saxon-style rim wire, ring of 15 shells on bell; festoon pattern on bell, rather like Schmied; in festoon pattern, four circles at peaks of festoon enclose a bird; excellent condition overall.
